newsitem.title: EGYPT: Yield falls on Egyptian 91-day T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yield falls on Egyptian 91-day T-bills.

text.p: The average yield on Egyptian 91-day treasury bills fell to 9.049 percent on Thursday from 9.480 percent at the previous auction on April 24.
The Central Bank of Egypt had asked for 900 million pounds and accepted bids for 1,003.05 million. Bills worth 768.725 million pounds mature today.
The Central Bank announced the following details (values in pounds, previous auction in brackets).
Value of bids accepted: 1,003.05 million (976.125 million)

Number of bids: 315 (254) *NOTE: August 14 is the maturity date for the auction held on May 14, July 24 is the maturity date for the auction held on April 24. Figures in brackets refer to details from auction held on April 24.
